selection_rationale: cand-2026-001-A directly targets the central open empirical question (RAG+validator+repair impact on first-pass misconfiguration), has a preregisterable, paired design with clear metrics, and strong feasibility evidence; required critiques are concrete and addressable prior to preregistration.
unresolved_uncertainties: Deterministic validator may under-capture production safety properties (unknown gap vs real deployments).
RAG corpus quality, coverage, and retrieval tuning could bias results and affect transferability to production docs.
Synthetic/topology-limited task set may not generalize across vendor implementations and complex topologies.
Provider/API rate limits, transient failures, or retry behavior could alter measured performance if not strictly controlled and logged.
required_repairs_before_preregistration: Specify exact deterministic validator implementation and ruleset (e.g., Batfish version or equivalent) and publish the validator rule corpus in the preregistration.
Freeze and publish the RAG corpus, retrieval index, embedding/retrieval model, vector-store settings, and retrieval method in the preregistration.
Define explicit inclusion/exclusion rules and provide fixed seeds/list for topology and synthetic-config generation to ensure paired, reproducible task sampling.

Predefine and publish a strict retry policy for provider/API failures (when retries are allowed, how retries are recorded, and how retried calls are treated in analysis) and require comprehensive retry logging in the execution manifest.
